sheets.title: The round buttons
sheets.brief: The bases of the buttons a thumb presses on a phone: a round boss, seen straight on, perfectly circular, filling its cell to the guide circle. The game draws an icon in the middle, so the middle is an empty, dark, slightly domed field. No icon, no gem in the centre.

cells.name: btn_round
cells.what: The ordinary button, at rest: a blackened iron disc with a bronze-gold rim worked in fine filigree, four tiny garnet studs at the compass points of the rim, the centre a dark, slightly domed field.

cells.name: btn_round_on
cells.what: The same button, pressed or switched on: identical shape and rim, the rim brighter gold and the centre lit with a warm inner glow, the garnets alight.

cells.name: btn_main
cells.what: The big main-attack button, at rest: the same make but grander, a heavier double rim with eight garnet studs and small pointed finials at the four compass points (kept inside the guide circle), the centre a dark domed field.

cells.name: btn_main_on
cells.what: The same big button, pressed: identical shape, rim blazing gold, centre lit from within.

sheets.title: Icons: what the thumbs do

cells.name: staff
cells.what: A wizard's staff held at a slant, its head a glowing orb throwing off three small sparks. The main attack.

cells.name: guard
cells.what: A kite shield, front on, plain steel face with a raised rim and a single boss. No device on it.

cells.name: jump
cells.what: A pair of worn leather boots leaving the ground, a small puff of dust under them, an upward sweep above.

cells.name: dodge
cells.what: A cloaked figure in a low sideways lunge with speed streaks trailing behind. A quick sidestep.

cells.name: sprint
cells.what: A single leather boot in mid stride, leaning forward, three speed streaks trailing behind it. Running.

cells.name: cast
cells.what: An open hand, palm up, with a four-pointed star of light bursting above it. Cast a spell.

cells.name: take
cells.what: A gloved hand reaching down to grasp, fingers spread. Pick something up.

cells.name: talk
cells.what: Two overlapping speech scrolls (curled parchment ribbons), blank. Talk to someone.

cells.name: open
cells.what: A heavy wooden door with iron bands, standing ajar, warm light spilling through the gap.

cells.name: shut
cells.what: The same heavy wooden door with iron bands, closed, a ring handle on it.

cells.name: locked
cells.what: An old iron padlock, closed, with a keyhole. A locked door.

cells.name: pack
cells.what: A traveller's leather backpack with a buckled flap and a bedroll strapped on top. The inventory.

cells.name: book
cells.what: A thick closed spellbook with metal corners and a clasp, a four-pointed star gem set in its cover.

cells.name: journal
cells.what: A rolled parchment scroll partly unrolled, with a quill pen lying across it. The quest journal.

cells.name: map
cells.what: A folded parchment map with a dotted path ending at a small red diamond, one corner curling.

cells.name: menu
cells.what: Three short horizontal iron bars stacked, each with a small rivet at both ends. The menu.

sheets.brief: Sixteen icons that sit on the round buttons. Pale bone-and-gold objects that read at a glance on a dark button at the size of a fingernail: one object each, bold silhouette, no frame, no background.

sheets.title: Icons: the menus

cells.name: view1
cells.what: A single open eye, heavy lidded, iris catching light. First-person view.

cells.name: view3
cells.what: A small robed wizard figure seen from behind and above, pointed hat, staff in hand. Third-person view.

cells.name: close
cells.what: Two short iron bars crossed on the diagonal, riveted where they meet (the one place in the set a crossed shape is wanted). Close.

cells.name: sort
cells.what: Three small stacked chests, biggest at the bottom, smallest on top. Sort the pack.

cells.name: plus
cells.what: A brass magnifying lens with a wooden handle, a bright four-pointed glint in its glass. Look closer.

cells.name: minus
cells.what: The same brass magnifying lens, held further off and smaller in its cell, its glass dark and plain. Look from further away.

cells.name: centre
cells.what: A brass compass rose with a needle, four points. Centre the map on yourself.

cells.name: resume
cells.what: A right-pointing arrowhead of polished gold. Resume.

cells.name: save
cells.what: A quill writing in an open book. Save the game.

cells.name: load
cells.what: An open book with a ribbon bookmark and a page turning back. Load a game.

cells.name: settings
cells.what: Two interlocking iron cogwheels. Settings.

cells.name: howto
cells.what: A lit candle beside an open book. How to play.

cells.name: home
cells.what: A small stone gatehouse with an arched doorway and a pointed roof. Main menu.

cells.name: gold
cells.what: A small heap of plain gold coins, blank faces. Gold.

cells.name: quest
cells.what: A gold four-pointed star with a small diamond at its centre. A quest marker.

cells.name: rotate
cells.what: A hand-held slate tablet shown twice: upright and faint, then lying on its side and solid, a curved arrow between them. Turn the screen sideways.

sheets.brief: Sixteen more icons of the same family as the first sheet, for the top bar and the menus. Same make, same weight, same palette.

sheets.title: The window frame
sheets.name: panel
sheets.brief: The frame of every window in the game (the pack, the spellbook, a conversation, the settings). One square frame filling the sheet edge to edge, seen straight on: a border of blackened iron with a bronze-gold inner bead, ornate corners with a small garnet stud in each, and a plain dark centre (near-black warm brown, very faint leather grain, no picture). The game cuts it in nine and stretches it: the four corners are kept as they are, so every ornament must stay inside the corner squares the template marks; the four sides between the corners must be plain, straight and the same all along their length; the centre must be even.

sheets.title: Spells: Fire

cells.name: firebolt
cells.what: Firebolt. Hold to gather it in the hand, up to two seconds, then it roars away and bursts where it lands. The longer it gathers, the harder it bursts.

cells.name: firebeam
cells.what: Fire Beam. Hold: a roaring jet of flame pours from your palms, searing and setting alight whatever it plays across.

cells.name: comet
cells.what: Cinderburst. A knot of cinders that bursts where it lands and scatters embers all round, each one a small fire of its own.

cells.name: wallfire
cells.what: Wall of Fire. Raises a wall of fire nine paces long where you look, for eight seconds. What crosses it goes up in flames.

cells.name: firenova
cells.what: Ring of Fire. A ring of flame rolls out from where you stand, scorching all it passes, and stands there six seconds as a moat: what crosses it burns.

cells.name: wyrm
cells.what: Flame Wyrm. A serpent of fire that weaves its own way to the nearest foe, and leaves the ground alight where it strikes.

cells.name: phoenix
cells.what: Phoenix. A firebird flies through everything in its way, dies in a ring of flame among them, and its ashes mend you.

cells.name: bomb
cells.what: Cinder Brand. Brands a foe with a coal that burns down and bursts. If the foe dies to it, the brand leaps to the two nearest.

cells.name: inferno
cells.what: Inferno. For twelve seconds you are wreathed in fire: all within reach burn, and the ground burns where you have walked.

cells.name: meteor
cells.what: Meteor. Calls a burning stone out of the sky onto where you look, and leaves the ground on fire.

cells.name: school_fire
cells.what: The emblem of the school of Fire: A single tall flame. Simple and bold, to sit on a tab.

sheets.brief: The ten spells of the school of Fire, and its emblem. Every icon on this sheet is lit by and coloured with the school's own colour, #ff9a3c, on the dark neutral ground of the style lock: one glowing magical effect in each cell, no hands, no figures, no frame or border round it (the game puts each in a round socket).

sheets.title: Spells: Ice

cells.name: frost
cells.what: Frost Shards. Three splinters of ice that shatter into frost and slow what they strike.

cells.name: coldcone
cells.what: Cone of Cold. A breath of winter from both hands: everything in a cone before you is cut by it and slowed.

cells.name: rime
cells.what: Rime Lance. A lance of ice that freezes what it strikes for a moment and bursts into shards all round.

cells.name: nova
cells.what: Frost Nova. Ice bursts out from where you stand: all within ten paces are frozen solid for five seconds, and take half again from every blow.

cells.name: frostray
cells.what: Ray of Frost. Hold: a ray of bitter cold that slows what it plays on, and freezes solid what it is held on long enough.

cells.name: prism
cells.what: Prismatic Shard. A crystal that splits on what it strikes into three beams of cold light, running on through everything behind and slowing it.

cells.name: blizzard
cells.what: Blizzard. Ice rains on the ground you mark for seven seconds, cutting and slowing all beneath.

cells.name: shatter
cells.what: Shatter. Every slowed foe within sixteen paces cracks. Every frozen one breaks out of its ice for twice as much, and the shards cut those beside it.

cells.name: orb
cells.what: Frozen Orb. A slow globe of ice that rolls through the fight throwing shards in every direction, then bursts.

cells.name: zero
cells.what: Deadwinter. Marks the ground you look at. A breath later all warmth leaves it: everything inside is frozen solid for six seconds.

cells.name: school_ice
cells.what: The emblem of the school of Ice: A six-armed ice crystal. Simple and bold, to sit on a tab.

sheets.brief: The ten spells of the school of Ice, and its emblem. Every icon on this sheet is lit by and coloured with the school's own colour, #8fd4ff, on the dark neutral ground of the style lock: one glowing magical effect in each cell, no hands, no figures, no frame or border round it (the game puts each in a round socket).

sheets.title: Spells: Earth

cells.name: stone
cells.what: Stone Shard. A fist of rock, thrown hard: it staggers what it strikes and knocks it back a step.

cells.name: lance
cells.what: Bone Lance. A spear of sharpened bone that runs through every body in its line and sticks quivering in the wall.

cells.name: thorns
cells.what: Thorn Volley. A fan of five thorns. What they strike is left rotting for four seconds.

cells.name: spikes
cells.what: Earthsplitter. Spikes of stone burst from the ground in a line before you, impaling what stands there and flinging it into the air.

cells.name: boulder
cells.what: Rolling Boulder. A boulder that bounds on from where it lands, three times, bursting among whatever is there each time. It hurts no one twice.

cells.name: plague
cells.what: Plague Flask. A lobbed flask that bursts in a choking green cloud: for nine seconds everything inside it rots and slows.

cells.name: stoneskin
cells.what: Stoneskin. Your skin turns to stone for twenty seconds: every blow that lands does a third less.

cells.name: vine
cells.what: Grasping Vines. Where it lands, vines come up under the five nearest, tear at them and hold them fast where they stand.

cells.name: quake
cells.what: Earthquake. The ground you mark heaves for six seconds: all on it are slowed, and every jolt, one each second and a half, batters them and throws them off their feet.

cells.name: monolith
cells.what: Monolith. A slab of stone bursts up under whatever you look at: one great blow that throws it into the air and leaves it stunned.

cells.name: school_earth
cells.what: The emblem of the school of Earth: A rough standing stone with a crack. Simple and bold, to sit on a tab.

sheets.brief: The ten spells of the school of Earth, and its emblem. Every icon on this sheet is lit by and coloured with the school's own colour, #d8b184, on the dark neutral ground of the style lock: one glowing magical effect in each cell, no hands, no figures, no frame or border round it (the game puts each in a round socket).

sheets.title: Spells: Arcane

cells.name: missiles
cells.what: Magic Missiles. Hold: spinning missiles fan out and hang in the air, more the longer you hold, and dart off one hard after another to seek a foe.

cells.name: arcaneblast
cells.what: Arcane Blast. A clap of raw force from both hands: everything in a cone before you is torn at and hurled back.

cells.name: blink
cells.what: Blink. Vanish and step out up to fourteen paces ahead, tearing through anything in the way.

cells.name: blades
cells.what: Spirit Blades. Four ghostly swords wheel round you for twenty seconds, hacking at anything that comes near.

cells.name: rune
cells.what: Rune of Force. Writes a rune on the ground where you look. The first foe to step on it is blown off its feet with everything near. Three may lie at once.

cells.name: crescent
cells.what: Moonblade. A spinning crescent that cuts its way out eighteen paces and comes back to your hand, cutting again.

cells.name: well
cells.what: Gravity Well. A mote of darkness that hangs where it lands, dragging all within ten paces into it, then bursts.

cells.name: stasis
cells.what: Stasis. A sphere where time stops. What is inside hangs there for three seconds, then pays for all of it at once.

cells.name: disintegrate
cells.what: Disintegrate. Hold: a lance of raw force through everything in its line, biting harder the longer it is held.

cells.name: starfall
cells.what: Starfall. Marks the ground you look at, and a moment later ten stars come down on it one after another.

cells.name: school_arcane
cells.what: The emblem of the school of Arcane: A crescent moon with one star. Simple and bold, to sit on a tab.

sheets.brief: The ten spells of the school of Arcane, and its emblem. Every icon on this sheet is lit by and coloured with the school's own colour, #d27bff, on the dark neutral ground of the style lock: one glowing magical effect in each cell, no hands, no figures, no frame or border round it (the game puts each in a round socket).

sheets.title: Spells: Lightning

cells.name: spark
cells.what: Spark. A crack of lightning straight to what you look at. Nothing outruns it.

cells.name: chain
cells.what: Chain Lightning. Hold: lightning streams from your palm, and from whatever it strikes it leaps to the nearest other, up to five times.

cells.name: fork
cells.what: Forked Lightning. Lightning that splits as it leaves the hand: three forks, each to a foe of its own before you.

cells.name: seed
cells.what: Storm Seed. A spark that sticks to what it strikes, or where it lands, for six seconds. Any lightning that strikes there leaps on to everyone within seven paces. Two may be set at once.

cells.name: lightning
cells.what: Ball Lightning. A slow sphere of storm that lashes everything around it, then detonates.

cells.name: thunderclap
cells.what: Thunderclap. A clap of thunder from where you stand: all within six paces are thrown back and left stunned.

cells.name: stormstep
cells.what: Stormstep. You go as lightning to the foe you look at, through everything between, and arrive on it in a crack of thunder that leaves it stunned.

cells.name: thunder
cells.what: Thunderbolt. Calls a bolt out of the sky onto where you look. What it strikes is stunned, if it lives.

cells.name: staticfield
cells.what: Static Field. For fifteen seconds lightning leaps from you to the three nearest foes within six paces, once a second.

cells.name: tempest
cells.what: Thunderstorm. A storm gathers over the ground you mark: for eight seconds bolt after bolt comes down on whoever is under it.

cells.name: school_lightning
cells.what: The emblem of the school of Lightning: A forked lightning bolt. Simple and bold, to sit on a tab.

sheets.brief: The ten spells of the school of Lightning, and its emblem. Every icon on this sheet is lit by and coloured with the school's own colour, #a79bff, on the dark neutral ground of the style lock: one glowing magical effect in each cell, no hands, no figures, no frame or border round it (the game puts each in a round socket).

sheets.title: Spells: Utility

cells.name: wisp
cells.what: Wisp Light. A spirit-light that follows you for ninety seconds and lights the dark.

cells.name: mend
cells.what: Mend. A circle of light closes your wounds, restoring 35 life.

cells.name: fleet
cells.what: Fleetfoot. The wind at your back: for twelve seconds you walk and run a third faster.

cells.name: turn
cells.what: Turn the Dead. Light breaks from your hand. The risen dead within nine paces are driven back, burning, and stand helpless a moment; anything else is dazed.

cells.name: renew
cells.what: Renew. Your wounds knit as you fight: sixty life, a little at a time, over ten seconds.

cells.name: drain
cells.what: Life Drain. Hold: a red thread fastens on the nearest foe before you and pulls its stolen life into yours.

cells.name: aegis
cells.what: Aegis. A shell of light that takes the next sixty points of harm for you, for twenty seconds or until it breaks.

cells.name: sanctuary
cells.what: Sanctuary. Hallows the ground where you stand for ten seconds. Inside it you mend and your mana comes back half again as fast; what means you harm is slowed and seared by it.

cells.name: empower
cells.what: Empower. Your next three spells bite two-fifths harder. Unspent, it fades in twenty seconds.

cells.name: stillness
cells.what: Stillness. The world slows to a crawl round you for four seconds, your company with it. You do not, and nor does what you cast.

cells.name: school_utility
cells.what: The emblem of the school of Utility: A radiant sun disc with short rays. Simple and bold, to sit on a tab.

sheets.brief: The ten spells of the school of Utility, and its emblem. Every icon on this sheet is lit by and coloured with the school's own colour, #ffd98a, on the dark neutral ground of the style lock: one glowing magical effect in each cell, no hands, no figures, no frame or border round it (the game puts each in a round socket).

sheets.title: Sockets and the medal
sheets.brief: Four round or square settings that things sit in, each filling its cell to the guide. Their centres are empty: the game draws what goes in them.

cells.name: slot_spell
cells.what: A round socket a spell's icon sits in: a thin dark iron ring with a narrow bronze-gold inner bead, the centre a dark recessed well. Plainer and thinner-rimmed than the buttons.

cells.name: slot_spell_on
cells.what: The same socket, chosen: identical shape, its rim glowing pale gold-white.

cells.name: slot_item
cells.what: A square cell of the paper doll that a piece of gear sits in: a recessed dark square with a thin bronze bevel and tiny corner rivets, the centre empty. Square, filling the guide square.

cells.name: medallion
cells.what: The round medal that carries the player's level number: a thick bronze-gold ring with a plain channel round it (the game fills the channel to show progress) and a dark domed centre for the number. No number, no emblem.

sheets.title: The map's rim and the stick
sheets.brief: Round pieces for the corner map and the left thumb's stick. Each fills its cell to the guide circle.

cells.name: ring_map
cells.what: The rim of the round corner map: a ring only, its whole centre empty and transparent (the map shows through). Blackened iron with a bronze-gold inner bead and four small pointed finials at the compass points, the top one a little larger. The ring is thin: its inner edge is at the inner guide circle.

cells.name: stick_base
cells.what: The base the thumbstick moves in: a wide, shallow, mostly see-through dark dish with a thin bronze rim and four faint tick marks at the compass points. Understated: it sits over the game's picture.

cells.name: stick_nub
cells.what: The thumbstick's knob: a domed disc of pale polished bone with a bronze collar, lit from the top left.

sheets.title: Buttons, tabs and the rule
sheets.brief: The flat rectangular pieces. Each is drawn straight on, filling its box. The game cuts each plate in nine and stretches it to any width, so the ends carry the ornament and the long middle is plain and even. No words on any of them.

boxes.name: button
boxes.what: A wide button plate, at rest: dark iron with a bronze-gold border, a small ornament at each end, plain dark middle.

boxes.name: button_on
boxes.what: The same plate, pressed or under the pointer: same shape, border bright gold, middle faintly lit.

boxes.name: tab
boxes.what: A tab, not chosen: like the button plate but flatter and dimmer, its top corners rounded.

boxes.name: tab_on
boxes.what: The same tab, chosen: brighter border, warm lit middle, a thin gold line along its bottom edge.

boxes.name: rule
boxes.what: A dividing rule that sits under a window's title: a thin gold line fading to nothing at both ends, with one small diamond-shaped garnet at its middle.

sheets.title: The bars
sheets.brief: The player's life, mana and breath, and a foe's life. First the trough they sit in, then four fills. Each fill is a long strip of one glowing substance, even from end to end (the game crops it to show how much is left), lit along its top edge. No end caps on the fills, no numbers.

boxes.name: bar_frame
boxes.what: The trough: a long dark iron channel with a bronze-gold border and a small ornate cap at each end, its middle plain and even (it is stretched). Empty inside.

boxes.name: bar_life
boxes.what: Life: deep blood red, glassy, a brighter band along the top.

boxes.name: bar_mana
boxes.what: Mana: luminous sapphire blue, like lit water.

boxes.name: bar_foe
boxes.what: A foe's life: dark crimson with an ember glow, harsher than the player's red.

sheets.title: Parchment
sheets.name: paper
sheets.brief: A sheet of old parchment for letters and pages the player reads: one square sheet filling the picture, seen straight on, warm cream-tan, darker and a little worn toward its edges, slightly ragged outline, even and blank across the middle. Cut in nine like the window frame: keep any tears, stains or curled corners inside the corner squares, and keep the sides and the middle plain.

sheets.title: Icons: empty gear slots, and two marks

cells.name: slot_head
cells.what: A wizard's pointed hat, as a faint engraved silhouette. An empty head slot.

cells.name: slot_shoulders
cells.what: A pair of shoulder guards on a short mantle, as a faint engraved silhouette.

cells.name: slot_neck
cells.what: A pendant on a chain, as a faint engraved silhouette.

cells.name: slot_chest
cells.what: A long tunic, sleeveless, as a faint engraved silhouette.

cells.name: slot_legs
cells.what: A pair of trousers, as a faint engraved silhouette.

cells.name: slot_feet
cells.what: A pair of boots, as a faint engraved silhouette.

cells.name: slot_ring
cells.what: A plain finger ring with one small stone, as a faint engraved silhouette.

cells.name: slot_main
cells.what: A tall staff standing upright, as a faint engraved silhouette. Fill the cell's height.

cells.name: slot_off
cells.what: A kite shield, blank, as a faint engraved silhouette.

cells.name: slot_skull
cells.what: A small plain human skull in profile, as a faint engraved silhouette. A spell focus the wizard carries.

cells.name: mark_branch
cells.what: A small faceted diamond-shaped crystal, point up. Marks a branch of a spell.

cells.name: mark_mastery
cells.what: A five-pointed star medal with a small gem at its centre. Marks a school's mastery.

sheets.brief: Ten faint silhouettes that show what goes in an empty gear slot, and two small marks for the spellbook. The silhouettes are dim, single-colour engravings (dull bronze, low contrast), not full paintings: they must not look like an item is there. Leave the last four cells empty.

sheets.title: Icons: goods, materials and charms

cells.name: bed
cells.what: A simple wooden bed with a red blanket and a pale pillow. A night at the inn.

cells.name: ale
cells.what: A wooden tankard banded with iron, foam on top.

cells.name: roll
cells.what: A round bread roll with a scored top.

cells.name: loaf
cells.what: A crusty loaf of bread on a board.

cells.name: dressing
cells.what: A roll of linen bandage with a sprig of green herbs.

cells.name: candle
cells.what: A lit tallow candle in a small holder.

cells.name: oil
cells.what: A small stoppered flask of lamp oil, amber through green glass.

cells.name: grave_candle
cells.what: A tall pale grave candle with wax runs, a soft pale flame.

cells.name: bone
cells.what: A few old bones crossed in a small pile. A crafting material.

cells.name: iron
cells.what: A stack of rough iron ingots with two nails. A crafting material.

cells.name: silk
cells.what: Folded bolts of pale spider silk. A crafting material.

cells.name: wax
cells.what: Three blocks of yellow beeswax. A crafting material.

cells.name: ember
cells.what: A glowing orange ember crystal, hot at its heart. A crafting material.

cells.name: wingbell
cells.what: A tiny silver bell with a swift's wing cast on its shoulder, hung on a violet thread. A charm.

cells.name: goatfoot
cells.what: A small cloven hoof shod in iron, hung on a leather thong. A charm.

cells.name: glimmerstone
cells.what: A shard of pale blue crystal bound in silver wire, faintly glowing. A charm.

sheets.brief: Sixteen small things bought, gathered and carried, painted in full colour as items: one object each, no frame, no background.

sheets.title: The app's icon
sheets.name: app_icon
sheets.brief: The icon on a phone's home screen. A full square picture with no transparency and no rounded corners (the phone rounds them): a great bronze church bell hanging in darkness, lit from below by a faint ember glow, on a near-black background with a subtle vignette. Keep the bell inside the middle 70% of the square (phones crop the edges). No letters, no title, no frame.
